in_sanskrit.name: श्रावन
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name Shrawan is derived from the Sanskrit word श्रावन (shravan), which means 'flowing', 'abundant', or 'bountiful'. It is also the name of the Hindu month of Shrawan, which is considered sacred for worshiping Lord Shiva.

in_hindi.name: श्रावन

in_telugu.name: శ్రావణ
in_telugu.long_meaning: The name Shrawan in Telugu is శ్రావణ (śrāvāṇa). It is derived from the Sanskrit word श्रावन (shravan), which means 'flowing', 'abundant', or 'bountiful'. In Telugu, the name is also written as శీర్షణ (śīrṣaṇa), which means 'lord of the head' or 'king of the senses'.
